reviews.t: The session with Emma was truly a gift. I had a lot of anxiety prior to the session and Emma seemed to understand this. I loved her humor and genuine connection. One message, probably the most important one, has created a space for more healing from childhood trauma. My daughter and I were just astounded with the accuracy of our mutual connected loved ones on the other side. I can't wait to book again and share Emma's gift with my friends and family. Blessings, Emma
What a wonderful experience this was. Emma was so kind and wow spot on with everything!! I will definatly see her again. Thank you !!

I really enjoyed my reading with Emma Divines. She was warm, kind, and made me feel comfortable from the start. Everything she shared felt thoughtful and personal, and she explained things in a way that was easy to understand. I left the reading feeling encouraged and with a lot to think about. It was a great experience overall, and I'd definitely recommend Emma Divines to anyone looking for an honest and meaningful reading.

Just had a deep dive session and it provided the clarity I needed! Emma is great at sharing what is being said on the other side and making those connections in my reading. Would absolutely recommend and will be booking with her agin in the future.

Emma did a reiki session and a house cleanse for me. I felt so clear and renewed afterwards. She made the whole experience so comfortable and explained everything so well!! 10/10 would recommend! Looking forward to working with her again

faqs.a: Book a time and jot down what’s on your mind. During the session, Emma shares what comes through and you can ask questions as you go. You leave with clarity, and a next step if you want one.

faqs.q: Can we talk by phone, or does it have to be video?
faqs.a: Either works. You can join by phone or by video call from anywhere, and you don’t need any special app. Email readings arrive by email within 1 business day.
Rescheduling is free with 24 hours’ notice or more. Later changes may carry a fee; the cancellation policy has the details.

faqs.q: Which session should I start with?
faqs.a: With one focused question, an Email or Quickie Reading is a gentle start. For more time and depth, try a Classic Reading. Still unsure? Draw a card.
